Read first: DI dictionary flags changed at source on Oct 27

  • m.davies (THR-405..413) added an impossible condition to dict-1, dict-3 and dict-neg1 flags (now never fire) and re-thresholded dict-7/15/31 (1x now ratio >=3). Any drop on these flags since Oct 27 is the edit, not the attacker. The dict-3 + dishort300 candidate (BLUE-7297) is on hold.

Biggest now

  • Uber SMS (Key 1): grease 2.1M / pagebio 1.9M on Oct 28 at 0% verified; 850k / 770k so far today, easing to ~24k/h in the last 6h. Ends-te 109k today at 69% verified - that part is getting through.
  • Amazon IDS (Key 2): grease 300k / pagebio 263k on Oct 28, 260k / 229k today, 10-14% verified, steady ~10-11k/h.
  • Highlight AI Chat Prompt: back - 100k today on grease and pagebio (4% verified), ~9k/h now. No ticket yet.
  • Airbnb Account Lookup: 52-69k today on grease/pagebio at 0% verified, mostly earlier in the day.
  • Microsoft Identity Signup: webgl 75k Oct 28, 73k today, 0-1% verified.
  • Roblox Login: webgl 12k, single-click 6k, dict-7 5.5k today at ~1% verified.

Getting through

  • Adobe Commerce: webgl ~22k/day at 85-95% verified.
  • Adobe ARP FF: webgl 56-66% verified.
  • Adobe Sign Up: ends-te 24k on Oct 28 at 70% verified (1.3k today).
  • Uber SMS ends-te 109k today at 69% verified.

Stopped

  • Roblox Game Join ends-te (55k Oct 27 -> ~0); Meta Login grease/pagebio down to ~1k; Roblox Login spoofed-OS surge stopped after Oct 28.

Appendix — how these were found

Daily run 2026-10-29, window Oct 25-28 (full 4 days) vs Oct 18-24, 1% SYSTEM sample. Step 1: 40 flags with >=3 keys spiking (ran first time). Dropped as artifacts, not attacks (following the 2026-10-27 run): cdn-header-order-only-have-single-cookie (54 keys, ~6.8M/day excess; created 2026-10-24 04:30 by c.koay, ticket 140244, baseline ~0). country-timezone-mismatch (79 keys; not edited since 2023, but the EU DST end on Oct 25 steps it up on every key; noisy until US DST ends Nov 1). ja4-dict-1-challenger and its duplicate ja4-dict-1-challenger-is-supicious-not-included (15 keys; the Oct 27 step change from an upstream JA4 dictionary or client change). g-ip-connection-type-velocity-short-term-abuse-wired-1point5x/2x/3x (11/8/6 keys; rule rewritten Oct 21 by s.alapati, ~0 before). g-cdn-ends-cl-rfc-ct-before-cl-tz-mismatch-grease (spike-scan TT created Oct 19; its name entered TELLTALE_LIST from 0 inside the baseline). DI dictionary edits by m.davies on 2026-10-27 02:06-04:17 UTC (none on Oct 28-29). dict-1 1x/5x/10x/LT, dict-3 1x/4x/LT and dict-neg1 ST/LT all now carry an impossible di_dictionary_num_matched == -99 condition, so they are disabled at source (THR-405..413). dict-7, dict-15 and dict-31 were re-thresholded: '1x' became ratio >= 3, '4x' became ratio >= 6 (descriptions say 'NAME NOT CHANGED ... RATIO IS 3x/6x'), and LT became long_term_ratio >= 3. So g-di-dict-7-match-short-term-threshold-exceeded-4x (5 keys in step 1) is a definition change inside the window and is dropped, and dict-7/15 1x are not used either. Drops on dict-3 combos after Oct 27 ~09 UTC are the edit. Ensemble-managed lists rewritten several times a day, treated as definition changes: g--e-g-ja4-suspicious-verification-patterns (6 keys; now 2 hashes, was 25 on Oct 22), g--e-ja4-global-cluster-strict (4 keys; 93-hash list) and g--e-capi-anomaly-missing-capi-version (5 keys; 376-key list re-dated Oct 28; the changelog call timed out twice, so this is not confirmed). Duplicates: sus-flag-cdn-header-order-has-sec-fetch-user (= g-cdn-header-order-has-sec-fetch-user), g-cdn-header-order-has-upgrade-insecure-requests (same sessions), cdn-header-order-contains-cache-control (= pragma).
